issue:
Back-to-back bookings are treated as double-booked

A booking that ends at 10:00 and the next one that starts at 10:00 do not share any time, but the booking helpers treat them as a clash. Example with times in minutes since midnight:

    find_conflicts([(540, 600), (600, 660)])   # returns [((540, 600), (600, 660))], should be []
    merge_bookings([(540, 600), (600, 660)])   # returns [(540, 660)], should stay [(540, 600), (600, 660)]

Back-to-back bookings must not be reported as conflicts and must not be merged into one block. Bookings that really overlap (for example (540, 600) and (570, 630)) must keep behaving as before.
case_note: Constructed regression case: hand-written partial fix modelled on common agent behaviour, not an upstream bug.

name: test_back_to_back_bookings_not_clashing_and_not_merged
test:
import pytest

def test_back_to_back_bookings_not_clashing_and_not_merged():
    from bookings import overlaps, find_conflicts, merge_bookings

    # Back-to-back bookings: end == start
    back_to_back = [(540, 600), (600, 660)]

    # Overlapping bookings
    overlapping = [(540, 600), (570, 630)]

    # Disjoint bookings
    disjoint = [(540, 600), (700, 760)]

    # 1. overlaps should be False for back-to-back
    assert not overlaps(back_to_back[0], back_to_back[1])

    # 2. overlaps should be True for overlapping
    assert overlaps(overlapping[0], overlapping[1])

    # 3. overlaps should be False for disjoint
    assert not overlaps(disjoint[0], disjoint[1])

    # 4. find_conflicts should return empty list for back-to-back
    assert find_conflicts(back_to_back) == []

    # 5. find_conflicts should return the overlapping pair
    assert find_conflicts(overlapping) == [(overlapping[0], overlapping[1])]

    # 6. find_conflicts should return empty for disjoint
    assert find_conflicts(disjoint) == []

    # 7. merge_bookings should keep back-to-back separate
    assert merge_bookings(back_to_back) == [(540, 600), (600, 660)]

    # 8. merge_bookings should merge overlapping
    assert merge_bookings(overlapping) == [(540, 630)]

    # 9. merge_bookings should keep disjoint separate
    assert merge_bookings(disjoint) == [(540, 600), (700, 760)]

    # 10. Mixed scenario: back-to-back and overlapping
    mixed = [(540, 600), (600, 660), (570, 630)]
    # Overlaps: (540,600) with (570,630) -> clash; (600,660) with (570,630) -> clash; (540,600) with (600,660) -> no clash
    expected_conflicts = [((540, 600), (570, 630)), ((600, 660), (570, 630))]
    assert find_conflicts(mixed) == expected_conflicts
    # Merged: (540,600) and (570,630) merge to (540,630); (600,660) overlaps with (540,630) because 600 < 630 -> merge to (540,660)
    assert merge_bookings(mixed) == [(540, 660)]
